feeds.title: Float Hub Blog
feeds.description: Float Hub is driven to provide deeper rest for all. Tom Euinton is the founder of Float Hub. After struggling with sleep apnea and insomnia for a long time, he received profound rest from floating that helped provide the deep recovery he wasn't getting from sleep. His float center is meticulously engineered for your rest. Discover a deeper state of relaxation with float therapy and floatation tanks in Shoreditch, London.

feeds.title: Float Boston Blog
feeds.description: FLOAT Boston is the largest and oldest float tank center in the metro area. They opened in February 2015 in Magoun Square, Somerville, MA. Sara Garvin and Colin Roald are the founders of Float Boston. She's a graduate of Kalamazoo College and the Chicago School of Massage Therapy, and has over twenty years of professional experience in the massage and spa industry. Their mission is to offer float therapy for wellness and stress relief. The blog serves the latest news and articles about float therapy.

feeds.title: True REST Float Spa Blog
feeds.description: Nick and Holly Janicki opened the first True REST Float Spa in 2009, after searching the globe for the most advanced available healing technologies for their own use. They spent months of research and planning and bet their life savings on this form of relaxation. It worked. Explore their blog for the latest news, fun facts and studies on True REST Flotation Therapy.

feeds.title: Red Lotus Float Spa Blog
feeds.description: Red Lotus Float Spa is committed to providing first-class service to a community that is sorely in need of what flotation therapy has to offer. They prize a pristine and serene environment, where you can relax and unwind. They are here to facilitate a deeply personal and healing experience. You will find interesting, (potentially) humorous, and informative posts about flotation therapy, meditation, sensory deprivation, being present, and much more.

feeds.title: Urban Float Blog
feeds.description: Urban Float is committed to providing a clean, calm, and welcoming environment so guests can get the most out of flotation therapy. Whether guests seek pain management, sports recovery, stress relief, improved focus, or simply disconnect from a hyper-connected world, they create a sanctuary to help everyone, everywhere improve their quality of life. Check out the floating blog for news & information on float therapy and different float spas near you.

feeds.title: Float Wellness Spa Blog
feeds.description: Float Wellness spa has been locally owned and operated since 2016. Their goal is to provide a beautiful and peaceful environment for healing and relaxation. Their space is filled with modalities that can not only help manage stress, but also boost your immune system, recover from injuries, expand consciousness, and release muscle tension. Learn more about the services float wellness spa offers by reading their blogs and e-books, reading their reviews, reading their FAQs, and more.

feeds.title: Halcyon Floats Blog
feeds.description: Halcyon Floats, Philadelphia's Favorite Float Center, is excited and proud to introduce the benefits of floating to the community. Keri, the owner, was introduced to floatation therapy while visiting a friend in Portland, OR in 2011. Commence obsessive mission to bring this amazing relaxation technique to the great people of Philadelphia, culminating in the place their city's floaters now call home, Halcyon Floats. Keep up with their Philadelphia Float studio, as well as updates in the world of sensory deprivation therapy, halotherapy, infrared saunas and more.

feeds.title: Water Temple Blog
feeds.description: Embark on a transformative journey towards inner peace and self-discovery from the moment you step foot into Water Temple Floatation and Holistic Health. Their personalized programs are designed to allow you the space to rest, rejuvenate, and reconnect with yourself amidst the pressures of modern life. Within their sanctuary, you will find solace, safety, and the nurturing environment you need. The blog contains insightful information and advice surrounding floatation therapy as well as health and wellbeing articles.

feeds.title: Float + Calm Spa Blog
feeds.description: Float and Calm Spa is a health and wellness spa. Its vision is to have a space that provides alternative ways to reduce stress, reduce pain, feel better, and learn about your individual needs. It offers massage therapy, esthetician services, infrared sauna, and float therapy. Each of its services was specifically chosen to be provided in order to provide its clients with mind, body, and spirit wellness. Their blog keeps you updated on the latest news on float.

feeds.title: The Float Centre Blog
feeds.description: At The Glasgow Float Centre, they are bringing the newest and best floatation sensation spa experience to the city. They are here to help you feel good! Floatation therapy can heal the most troubled mind, body, and soul. Within a fully soundproofed room, this state-of-the-art unit is filled with around a foot of water packed with 500kg of Epsom salt that allows you to float weightlessly and completely free of any external stimuli for a whole hour. Check out the advantages and healing done via float therapy.

feeds.title: Float Seattle Blog
feeds.description: Andrew is PNW born-and-raised and an explorer at heart and owns Float Seattle along with Dean. Andrew's mission is to provide space for relaxation, healing, and growth for anyone seeking wellness on their own terms. Dean has done a little bit of everything. He's a former chef, student of trans-personal psychology and comparative mythology, professional DJ, and local business professional with over twenty years of experience. Learn about Sensory Deprivation/Float Tanks/Float Therapy/REST and how this one activity eases so many areas of one's life.

feeds.title: The Float Zone Blog
feeds.description: Dr. David A. Berv is the Chief Experience Officer of Float Zone. He is a retired Sports Chiropractor and Diplomate in Acupuncture. He has served on hospital panels, has been the team doctor for professional sports teams, and has treated high-level athletes in almost every sport. The Float Blog highlights many of the reasons why people float especially to address medical conditions, chronic pain, or other physical conditions.

feeds.title: Float State Blog
feeds.description: As an estimator and project manager for a large construction company, James Sirls found myself struggling with the everyday emotional and physical stressors of a constant on-the-go lifestyle. Using his background and passion for construction, and a years' worth of research traveling to float centers all over the west coast, Float State was born. They have created a state-of-the-art facility that revolutionizes the way people improve their health. The blog provides research, findings, benefits, and more.

feeds.title: Time To Float Blog
feeds.description: Time To Float is a state-of-the-art facility. Their floatation pods sessions can actively improve body ailments and boost serotonin, leaving you feeling healthier and happier! Bringing you the in's and out's of Floatation Therapy and why you should try out their Sensory Deprivation Pod at their Floatation Centre based in Staffordshire.

feeds.title: The Float Society Blog
feeds.description: At The Float Society, they are your sanctuary for holistic wellness and communal connection. They offer a unique blend of therapeutic modalities designed to nurture your mind, body, and spirit. Dominic D. is the founder at The Float Society and Harmonics of the sun. Dominic has studied stillness in the temples of Thailand and has built a heart-based community with world-renewed mastermind groups who together have learned how to pray in the mountains of Ecuador. Their blog page is a collection of actionable methods, supplements, and practices that help you create a better quality of life.

feeds.title: Main Line Float and Freeze Blog
feeds.description: Main Line Float and Freeze was created for the community to facilitate Health & Wellness. They have developed a facility with state of the art therapeutic technology that is revolutionizing how people improve their health. Flotation Therapy, Cryotherapy, Infrared Sauna and Compression Therapy are some of their main services. The blog serves articles about float therapy.

feeds.title: 180 Float Spa Blog
feeds.description: 180 Float Spa is owned and operated by Angela and Brad Heavner in Boone, NC. The company was established because of how strongly the couple believe in Float Therapy (or Sensory Deprivation) and its benefits. They offer a customizable experience that includes the options of ambient light and music, or their Deluxe Float Suite, with 7 foot ceilings, for those uncomfortable in confined spaces. The blog features detailed articles about guides, rainy day activities, and more.

feeds.title: Blissful Waters Float Center Blog
feeds.description: Blissful Waters offers float rooms in beautiful private suites designed for your comfort and relaxation. Complementing their float sessions are their zero gravity massage chairs to get you in the right frame of mind to start you float. They offer Contrast Therapy and Brain Tap technology as complimentary services. Their caring and attentive staff is here to ensure you experience at Blissful Waters Float Center has you leaving with a healthy body, healthy mind and healthy spirit.

feeds.title: Fort Worth Float Company Blog
feeds.description: Fort Worth Float specializes in providing sensory deprivation flotation tanks, providing the ultimate relaxation experience. They work towards melting your stress away and bringing you true peace and quiet. Their blog gives you insights into the world of floatation.

feeds.title: Float Lab Blog
feeds.description: At Float Lab they are true to the science of floating. Their mission is to ensure their clients receive the best sensory deprivation experience available in Perth. Their passion is to introduce floating to a wider audience, we spent a number of years researching floating studies, the industry internationally, float studio construction, and building products and techniques. Educate yourself on the topic of sensory deprivation is a therapy proven to aid in the recovery of the body & is used to treat injury, and aid with muscle relaxation, stress & anxiety relief.

feeds.title: Limitless Float Blog
feeds.description: Limitless Float is a float therapy center offering relief from chronic back pain, depression & anxiety, exhaustion & lack of sleep, sports injury, and pregnancy with associated pelvic pain (PGD/ SPD). It provides you with rest, and relief and allows you to recover. Its bog is loaded with helpful articles about the benefits of float, relieving stress, keeping the pods clean, and much more.

feeds.title: Luna Float Spa Blog
feeds.description: Courtney and Arielle Thomas are the owners of the Luna Float Spa. Luna Float Spa isn't just a place; it's an experience. It is a testament to Arielle's dedication to holistic well-being and her passion for bridging the physical with the spiritual. Courtney merged his passions into Luna Float Spa & Salt Cave, an emblem of his commitment to holistic growth. Beyond the serenity of spa walls, his deeper calling lies in Conscious Development Coaching's blend of age-old wisdom, modern techniques, and introspective discoveries. Understand how float works, transcendental meditation, and more.

feeds.title: Sense Zero Float Center Blog
feeds.description: Denis Rams is the proud owner and manager of Sense Zero Float Center. They provide a state-of-the-art luxurious facility where members can practice unprecedented relaxation. Their blog will provide you with valuable information and inspiration for incorporating float therapy into your self-care routine.

feeds.title: Victory Float Lounge Blog
feeds.description: Lindsey & Casey opened their float studios with the understanding and acknowledgment that everyone is fighting their own battles - pain, stress, lack of sleep, anxiety, etc. Learn more about the benefits of sensory deprivation from the Victory Float Spa founders. From couples therapy & anxiety remediation to athletic recovery & pain relief, float tanks can help you be at your best.

feeds.title: IMR Float Blog
feeds.description: At IMR Float, they provide their guests with state-of-the-art flotation tanks. Their tanks are spacious and elegant. It is the highest-rated massage company in Las Vegas, specializing in sports massage and cupping therapy. The spa features two float cabins (including one large enough for partners to float together), Nevada's only open float room, a fire & ice contrast therapy room, and an infrared sauna. Read about all things float therapy and wellness-related.

feeds.title: Nepsis Floatation Blog
feeds.description: Nepsis Flotation strives to relieve your stress and improve the quality of your life by raising self-awareness, body, and mind, in an inclusive, supportive environment. It provides soaps, shampoo, conditioner, towels, facecloths, earplugs, lotion, a place to do your hair and makeup after your float, and a cuppa to complete your day. Its blog offers insights into the science of floatation therapy.

feeds.title: Hope Floats Blog
feeds.description: Hope Floats is a small business that started in the home of Kimberly Boone in 2013. With a single flotation tank in her basement-turned-spa, she welcomed a handful of clients to experience flotation therapy. News spread via word of mouth and the business grew, establishing the need for a larger space and additional tanks. Browse the blog to learn about vitamins, Epsom salts, contrast therapy, and more.

feeds.title: Exo Float Blog
feeds.description: Experience unparalleled quality with their state-of-the-art Exo float tank. Designed for ease of installation, operation, and maintenance, this sensory deprivation tank is constructed from premium materials and showcases the leading edge of float technology. Equipped with remote assistance, thorough filtration, and advanced UV sterilization, the Exo tank is the benchmark for hygiene and functionality in the market. Find the latest news, insights, and innovations in float tank and sensory deprivation technology.

feeds.title: The Floatation Sanctuary Blog
feeds.description: At The Floatation Sanctuary, their mission is to provide a holistic approach to wellness, helping their clients discover the profound benefits of floatation therapy. Their team is dedicated to promoting both physical and mental health by harnessing the power of floatation therapy, tailored to meet each client's unique needs.

feeds.title: Float Research Collective
feeds.description: Dr. Feinstein is an expert in the neuroscience of fear who is trailblazing a new path forward for the treatment of anxiety. His current work is focused on studying the intimate connection between the body & the brain and developing new technologies to help bring this connection to the forefront of awareness. He shares his experiences and research on his blog.

feeds.title: Floataway
feeds.description: Floataway is a design-based British company. Its strength, as a small company in a global market, is in its technology roots. It is able to offer a comprehensive design consultancy and implementation service for organizations, companies, and individuals. Their founder, Colin studied Mechanical Engineering in Bristol, England, and took an apprenticeship at the British Aircraft Corporation working on Concorde. The blog offers news, articles and more on float therapy.

feeds.title: H2Oasis Float Center and Tea House Blog
feeds.description: H2Oasis Float Center & Tea House is Northeastern Oklahoma's largest float center. They offer a variety of services within their center: tea house and oxygen bars, floatation therapy sessions, massage services, classes/workshops, and more. They have designed their float rooms to maximize your comfort and provide an unforgettable experience. They offer beautiful round float pools/tanks that can be used for singles or couples floating. Read articles that help you stay healthy.

feeds.title: Zero Gravity Float Blog
feeds.description: Zero Gravity Float facilitates great float experiences from start to finish, They do this to inspire you so that you might inspire yourself to do the things that you love to do. They aim to provide you with the finest floatation experience in a clean, tranquil, relaxed environment, to help you embrace your dreams, expand your thinking, and to help you be your very best. Learn more about floating, its origins, benefits, and methods, on their carefully curated Float Blog. Maintained by their expert float staff.

feeds.title: Float Harder Blog
feeds.description: Float Harder sensory deprivation tanks will help you relax your muscles and clear your mind. If you experience chronic pain, enjoy meditation, feel overwhelmed by sensory overload, are looking for that competitive edge, or just want to relax, then treat yourself to a session in one of their float pods or float rooms! Read the blog written by industry experts. Float today!

feeds.title: Float Therapy Wilmslow Blog
feeds.description: Float Therapy Wilmslow's floatation tanks have been proven to boost creative thinking because of being free from distraction, enabling your mind to freely imagine. Their floatation tanks, known as the i-sopod, have been expertly designed to transport you to a land of peace and tranquillity, helping you re-centre and restore a sense of calm. This blog delves into the remarkable advantages of sensory deprivation tank therapy, exploring how it offers deep relaxation, pain relief, improved sleep, emotional well-being.

feeds.title: The Salty Turtle Blog
feeds.description: The Salty Turtle Float Center is the only floatation therapy center in Lancaster County. They provide open floatation rooms not restricted 'pods' for a calming customer experience. Their rooms feature fully automated lighting and music therapy to enhance your floatation experience. Learn more about what's new or important at The Salty Turtle Float Center of Lancaster, PA.

feeds.title: Bliss Float Centre Blog
feeds.description: Bliss Float Centre is Kamloops' only Float Centre. They are a locally owned small business with an incredibly passionate team of amazing humans behind the desk. Their friendly and knowledgeable staff will assist you with your floating experience. Explore their blog to know more about float therapy.

feeds.title: Float North County Blog
feeds.description: At Float North County, they are here to change the way you think about wellness. Floating is the easiest and one of the most effective personal development tools available. Their only goal is to get people floating. They are devising ways to integrate guided musical journey sessions. They are always working on bringing in cool stuff, and they will be sure to update as they grow and evolve. Have questions about floating? Want to know more about the benefits of floating? Find out more here!
